newsitem.title: USA: Clarcor CEO retains posts through March 2000.
newsitem.headline: Clarcor CEO retains posts through March 2000.

text.p: Clarcor Inc said Monday its chairman and chief executive officer, Lawrence Gloyd, age 64, will continue with the company through its annual meeting in March 2000.
Clarcor said Gloyd was asked to stay as chairman and chief executive officer to oversee the company's long-term goals and integration of recent acquisitions.
Clarcor also said Norman Johnson, 48, president and chief operating officer, is expected to become chief executive officer when Gloyd retires.
Clarcor also said it completed its acquisition of Airklean Engineering Pte Ltd, a Singapore distributor of air filtration products.

"Though Airklean is a small company, it will provide Clarcor with a base to establish manufacturing operations for industrial/environmental filter production in Southeast Asia," Gloyd said in a statement. "We expect to have a facility in operation by the end of 1997 or early in 1998."
CLARCOR makes and markets mobile and environmental filtration products and consumer products.
